notes.title: Dream Girlfriend: Doomer Girl is coming soon!
notes.content:
We are excited to introduce our new game Dream Girlfriend: Doomer Girl! We've listened to your feedback and have made a lot of improvements. Feel free to add the game to your wishlist so you won't miss its release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051080

notes.title: The Game is out!
notes.content: Thanks for waiting for the release! Have fun! :)
